findings.title: Concurrent referral claims can award the same referral twice
findings.scenario: Tom shares his friend referral with Sara. Sara has a verified account and submits the same claim twice at the same time. Both claims can succeed, giving Tom two 100-Pill rewards for referring Sara once; the extra credit can pay for shifts.
findings.test_needed: Submit two concurrent first claims by verified Sara for Tom's same referral code, synchronizing their initial lookups; assert one claimed referral and one 100-Pill credit.

owner_question.question: When Sara submits Tom's same referral claim twice simultaneously, what should Tom receive?
options: One reward, with both submissions resolving to the same referral
One reward, with the duplicate submission rejected
